_notes: UT99-style kill announcements. The words are the classic ones. The counts are lower than UT99, because a 3v3 round ends at 15 team kills: the classic 5/10/15/20/25 spree steps never happen in this format. `heavyHitShare` is the share of full health that one hit must take to be called out; a measurement of six rounds found single sniper hits of 85 to 194 against 100 health, and those, not crits, are what drop a bot from near full health (Section 7.24).
